claims.evidence_distinction: Local inference from explicit training procedures; the prior size1 table and its implementation mapping are separate facts.
claims.finding: The target trains on separate observation pairs without supplied same-program groups or program labels. Transfer evaluation nevertheless supplies a same-program support/query pair. LPN Sec.4.3/Algorithm2 and NLI base training use grouped leave-one-out reconstruction; neither requires program labels. LPN p.21 Table7 explicitly reports training specification size1, as well as singleton test specifications. Its p.37 Algorithm2 samples n same-program pairs and divides by n-1, so substituting n=1 into that printed algorithm is undefined. A size1 context plus a held-out target is a plausible reconciliation, not a verified mapping of the ablation implementation. Therefore single-example test-time inference is not novel, and an absence of every singleton-training prior variant is not established. Weaker training information remains a positive contribution candidate relative to the stated grouped procedures; independent Pro suggests scoped L2, while first Pro and local adjudication retain U pending exact ablation/version mapping and matched-information comparisons.

claims.evidence_distinction: Direct architectural descriptions support overlap and differences; novelty/priority is an inference with missing evidence.
claims.finding: NLI already describes learned discrete reusable program tokens and a shared sequential neural executor. NEO adds goal-conditioned stepwise proposals, continuously encoded state grounding and ungrouped training; NLI proposes whole programs, re-embeds observation symbols with a skip and may execute optimized soft tokens. LPN uses one continuous program vector but its decoder autoregressively generates output pixels, so one latent does not mean one computational step. Positive abstract submechanism overlap is supported. First Pro proposed narrow L0, independent Pro U; local U retains unresolved earlier byte chronology and unequal information conditions. Neither whole-paper equivalence nor historical inheritance is inferred.

claims.evidence_distinction: Author-reported ablations; directly checked printed equations; bounded mathematical inference; implementation unknown.
claims.finding: Both versions present a variational motivation but use practical VQ/reconstruction/grounding losses without computing the stated KL term or proving objective equivalence. Eq.5 weights error by lambda^k: equal positive error is cheaper at longer lengths when lambda<1, and zero errors tie at every length. This alone is not a formal minimum-description-length or identification guarantee. Original algorithms print lambda without k; current algorithms include k. Current p.8 reports primitive score1 to0.002 and zero listed accuracies after removing grounding; this is evidence for necessity in those experiments, not uniquely correct causal states. Printed state indices, truncation and the NLI main-versus-appendix distinct-token penalty discrepancy remain implementation questions. Saved exact finite checks concern formulas only; author code was not executed.

claims.evidence_distinction: Direct metric definitions and author limitations; finite logical counterexample; learned-model semantics remain unverified.
claims.finding: The printed primitive score averages a per-example maximum over codes, which does not require one fixed code to realize the same primitive on every input. A saved two-input/two-constant-code construction achieves score1 without such a global assignment. Alignment criteria and image heatmaps add finite behavioral evidence, but raw matrices and universal operator recovery are unavailable. Current image text reports three newly assigned codes for five remaining primitive categories, not recovery of all five. Equivalent composite functions (for example two90degree rotations versus horizontal plus vertical flip) and commuting arithmetic operations further separate program strings from unique semantics. Authors explicitly limit causal and human-interpretability claims. No inference that the actual trained model fails solely because the metric admits a counterexample.

claims.evidence_distinction: Direct evidence is what the tables report. Performance beyond those settings and repeatability remain unknown.
claims.finding: At Grid alpha0.33 the reported NEO compositional/length accuracies are0.933/0.845, rising to0.976/0.907 with B64; displayed monolithic OOD baselines are zero. Grid ID accuracy is0.911 for NEO versus0.983 for Disc-Mono, so superiority is not uniform. Arithmetic alpha0.66 length accuracy rises0.019 to0.696 with B1024 and composition0.573 to0.959; without search the length result is weak. Images alpha0.33 report compositional/length L1 errors0.12/0.13 versus0.16/0.19 for the best displayed monolithic baseline. These task-specific author means support bounded behavioral generalization, not unique true theories, statistical certification or a reproduction. Different LPN/NLI tasks, support counts, output metrics and compute prevent cross-paper dominance claims; alpha1 has no held-out composition test.

claims.evidence_distinction: Author-reported times and printed algorithm checked; no local timing, raw runs or budget-matched causal attribution.
claims.finding: Algorithm3 filters candidates by support consistency, chooses the modal consistent program and only then scores the query. A declared query target is not evidence of leakage; this is select@B, not oracle pass@B. Current pp.29-30 report arithmetic27.5ms base versus4867.3ms at B1024 on RTX4090/batch512, and Grid41.1ms base versus174ms at B64 on RTX3090/batch128. These are batch timings, not single-example timings measured locally. Grid total training time5890s versus5835/5882s does not support a uniform twofold total-cost claim, even when per-batch or other tasks differ. The timing table lists150 epochs for Grid Cont-Mono while its hyperparameter table lists100; exact runs are unknown. Cont-Mono-Opt adapts a single-pair VAE rather than reproducing grouped LPN training; there is no direct NLI baseline. Pretraining, sampling, gradient search, hardware and budgets are not matched.

claims.evidence_distinction: Direct version and table comparisons; possible explanations are hypotheses, not authenticated implementation history.
claims.finding: Original40/current43 pages preserve the core mechanism and main table values, rename NLTP to NEO, and add NLI/cost/data/execution-limit discussion. Pixels confirm arithmetic alpha0.33 held-out primitives change from times7/times3 to times3/times5, alongside composition lists, while the main means stay unchanged. Both Grid split lists print DDR in training and compositional OOD; image string splits include functionally equivalent compositions. Original StateVAE beta2e-5 becomes current unpaired-number embedding reconstruction detail; mask50percent becomes25percent while both say top-left quadrant. Grid count discrepancies may count pairs versus examples; arithmetic counts also lack an exact mapping. These are document-level issues requiring data/code/run/version attribution, not established test leakage, retraining, invalid results or misconduct. All canonical camera-ready mappings and precise earlier-content chronology remain unknown.

disagreements.local: U; positive capability candidate, prior size1 ablation and matched conditions unresolved
Shared mechanism confirmed; U for historical coverage under matched conditions
